summary: Verified 4 fixes/changes in Conactivos HR mobile app via Playwright at 390x844. TEST 1 (¡Hola! text): PASS. TEST 2 (Employee detail / unmatched-route fix): PASS - clicking an employee card opens the detail screen with name, position, correo, teléfono, fecha de cumpleaños, fecha de ingreso; no 'unmatched route' error. TEST 3 (Create Employee - admin): API works (POST /api/auth/register returned 200, employee count went from 13 → 15 after two creations), form renders all required fields. BUG FOUND: React Native Alert.alert('Éxito', ...) does not render on RN Web preview, so the user never sees a success confirmation and router.back() (which fires from the OK button callback) never runs - the form remains visible after a successful create, giving the user no feedback. TEST 4 (Employee permission check): PASS - juan.perez@conactivos.com logged in, add-employee-btn and reports-btn are NOT visible; employee can still open detail screens. Additional deprecation warnings observed (Image style.tintColor, pointerEvents) and a benign Expo Router warning about a stale 'empleados' Stack.Screen entry in root _layout.tsx.

ui_bugs.issue: Alert.alert('Éxito', 'Empleado creado correctamente', [{text:'OK', onPress: router.back()}]) does not display on React Native Web. After a successful POST /api/auth/register (200), the user sees no confirmation and stays on the form. router.back() is gated on the OK press so navigation never happens on web. Consider replacing with a cross-platform toast/inline banner or calling router.back()/router.replace('/empleados') immediately after success (before/without the alert) on web.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: 'Image: style.tintColor is deprecated. Please use props.tintColor.' Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:314 (styles.logoIcon uses tintColor inside StyleSheet). Move tintColor to the Image prop.

Console warning: '[Layout children]: No route named "empleados" exists in nested children: [..., empleados/[id], empleados/index, empleados/nuevo]'. There is a stale Stack.Screen name="empleados" entry in the root layout that no longer matches the file-based folder route. Remove/rename it to silence the warning.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' - likely coming from a library, low priority.

action_items: Fix success feedback in /app/frontend/app/empleados/nuevo.tsx: RN Web Alert.alert is not visible - use a cross-platform Toast or immediately call router.back()/router.replace('/empleados') on success (Alert.alert on native only, or use Alert on iOS/Android and window.alert or inline banner on web).
Move tintColor from styles.logoIcon to the Image tintColor prop in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx.
Remove stale Stack.Screen name="empleados" entry from the root _layout.tsx (file-based routing now handles empleados/index, empleados/[id], empleados/nuevo).
critical_code_review_comments: empleados/nuevo.tsx: birthdate is sent as toISOString().split('T')[0] which uses UTC and may off-by-one for users in negative UTC offsets; fine for current use but worth noting.
empleados/nuevo.tsx: no client-side check that current user is admin - relies on UI hiding add-employee-btn and backend enforcement (OK, backend rejects non-admin).

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (create flow works but lacks visible success feedback on web)

seed_data_creation: Two test employees were created via the form during testing (test.qa.1783124369@conactivos.com, test.qa.1783124439@conactivos.com). Employee count went from 13 → 15. Consider cleanup from DB if not needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 target features work at the API/logic level. The only real user-visible bug is that Alert.alert('Éxito',...) is silent on RN Web preview in empleados/nuevo.tsx, so the create-employee UI never confirms success and never navigates back. Also two extra test employees were seeded in DB.
rca_of_issue: React Native's Alert.alert is not implemented natively on react-native-web; multi-button alerts are commonly no-op on web. Because router.back() lives inside the Alert's OK onPress callback, on the web preview the navigation is never triggered even though the backend request succeeded (POST /api/auth/register 200). Fix: either (a) call router.back()/router.replace on success before/without the Alert, (b) use Platform.OS check to fall back to window.alert on web, or (c) replace with a cross-platform toast (e.g., react-native-toast-message).
